## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
- dd-1: Scratch path added to tickets-tracker worktree's .git/info/exclude (per epic Approach — not committed .gitignore); git check-ignore confirms

## Description
Modify plugins/dso/scripts/ticket-init.sh to append `.scratch/` to tickets-tracker .git/info/exclude. Resolve exclude path via `git rev-parse --git-path info/exclude` (NOT hardcoded — tickets-tracker is a linked worktree where .git is a file). Before appending, grep for existing exact-match `.scratch/` line; skip if present. Append-only with newline guard; never rewrite. Turns task-1 and task-2 GREEN.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] bash tests/run-all.sh exits 0
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint passes
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] task-1 RED test now passes
  Verify: bash tests/scratch/test-scratch-gitignore.sh
- [ ] task-2 RED test now passes
  Verify: bash tests/scratch/test-scratch-isolation.sh
- [ ] ticket-init.sh uses git rev-parse to resolve exclude path
  Verify: grep -q 'git rev-parse --git-path info/exclude' plugins/dso/scripts/ticket-init.sh
- [ ] Append is idempotency-guarded (grep before append)
  Verify: grep -q scratch plugins/dso/scripts/ticket-init.sh && grep -qE '(grep -q|grep -F)' plugins/dso/scripts/ticket-init.sh

## File Impact
| Path | Action |
|---|---|
| plugins/dso/scripts/ticket-init.sh | Edit |

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 sonnet → opus → user.
data.title: Modify ticket-init.sh to add .scratch/ to .git/info/exclude (idempotent)
